title: Mummy Sorcerer in Desert
description: A green-skinned mummy wrapped in bandages sits on an engraved stone throne in a desert, holding a glowing blue magical circle in one hand while purple tentacles emanate from its body. Small purple demonic figures emerge from the sand to the left as the mummy's other hand rests near its face, with ancient ruins and a dramatic sunset sky in the background.
prompt: A green-skinned mummy wrapped in tattered bandages sits cross-legged on an ancient Egyptian stone throne in the middle of a vast desert. The mummy has glowing eyes and holds a large glowing blue magical sigil in one hand while purple energy tentacles swirl around its body. Small purple demonic figures rise from the sand to the left. Dramatic sunset with orange and purple clouds in the sky, ancient ruins visible in the distance, mystical blue energy effects, highly detailed digital fantasy art
